means.example-sentence: Suffice it to say that she didn’t do her duty as she was supposed to have done.
means.sentence-jp: 彼女は果たすべきだった義務を果たさなかったと言えば十分であろう。

cloze.maskedText: ____ she didn’t do her duty as she was supposed to have done.

notes: 古びた表現であるが、ときに今も使われる。Suffice は仮定法現在。現代的語順では、It suffices to say that ...。
